name: ImageNet (ILSVRC 2012)
description: The ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge 2012 (ILSVRC2012) dataset is one of the most widely used benchmarks in computer vision. It contains 1,000 object categories with over 1.28 million training images, 50,000 validation images, and 100,000 test images, organized according to the WordNet hierarchy.

license.name: ImageNet Terms of Access (Non-Commercial Research and Educational Use)
license.notes: Access requires account registration with a verified institutional email address and agreement to the ImageNet Terms of Access. The dataset is restricted strictly to non-commercial research and educational use. ImageNet does not own the copyright of individual images.
